line-siege.goal: Stop every monster before it reaches your wall.
line-siege.how-to-play.step-1: Pick a block and place it on the grid.
line-siege.how-to-play.step-2: Fill a column to fire a beam up its lane.
line-siege.how-to-play.step-3: Fill a row to hit every monster at once.
line-siege.how-to-play.step-4: The monsters march closer every few blocks.
line-siege.name: Line Siege
line-siege.tagline: Clear lines. Fire beams. Hold the wall.
line-siege.tutorial.step-1: Tap a block, then tap the grid to place it.
line-siege.tutorial.step-2: Fill this column to fire up its lane!
line-siege.tutorial.step-3: A full row hits every monster at once.
line-siege.tutorial.step-4: Careful: the monsters march closer every few blocks.
